ca-06053-bos-matter-67051.label: ORD 26-021
ca-06053-bos-matter-67051.title:
REF22020 - Housing Element Update 
Public hearing to consider adopting the County of Monterey Sixth Cycle (2023-2031) Housing Element Update (HEU6) and all necessary implementation actions including amendments to the 2010 General Plan, the Local Coastal Program, and Monterey County Code Titles 18, 20 and 21.
Project Location: Countywide 
Proposed California Environmental Quality Act (“CEQA”) action: Certify a Final Programmatic Environmental Impact Report (PEIR), adopt a Mitigation and Monitoring Reporting Program (MMRP), and adopt a Statement of Overriding Considerations pursuant to Public Resources Code Section 21081(a)(1), (b) and CEQA Guidelines Section 15093(b).

ca-06053-bos-matter-67052.label: ORD 26-022
ca-06053-bos-matter-67052.title:
Public hearing to consider adoption of an ordinance to extend an interim urgency ordinance to make findings and extend a temporary moratorium on the siting, construction, conversion, and/or operation of new or expanded detention facilities and correctional facilities within the unincorporated area of Monterey County, to the full extent authorized under federal and state law (4/5th vote required).

Proposed California Environmental Quality Act (“CEQA”) action: Find the adoption of this ordinance will not result in a direct or reasonably foreseeable indirect physical change in the environment under CEQA Guidelines section 15060(c)(2), and that the interim ordinance is categorically exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines section 15308 as a regulatory action taken by the County to assure maintenance and protection of the environment.

ca-06053-bos-matter-67053.label: RES 26-184
ca-06053-bos-matter-67053.title:
PLN240362 - KSHIRE PROPERTY INVESTMENTS, LLC 
Public Hearing to consider:
a. Appeals by Carol Bernstein, and Sebastian Miller and Sarah Miller of the August 27, 2026, Zoning Administrator’s Resolution approving a Combined Development Permit and water allocation; and
b. Find the project qualifies for Class 1 and Class 3 Categorical Exemptions pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines sections 15301 and 15303, and there are no exceptions to either Exemption under Section 15300.2; and
c. Approve the demolition of an existing 646 square foot single-family dwelling, and construction of a 2,531 square foot single family dwelling with an attached 263 square foot garage, and an 800 square foot attached accessory dwelling unit, with associated site improvements including development within 750 feet of archaeological resources, removal of three oak trees, and water allocation not to exceed 0.159-acre feet of water per year (AFY) for the single family dwelling from the County’s “First Come, First Served” category and water allocation not to exceed 0.101 AFY for accessory dwelling unit from the County’s “Planned Housing Growth” category pursuant to Board Policy No. G-269.
